overview_description.description:
Mindset is building AI therapeutics for physical health conditions, powered by a specialized model for psychophysiology. 

Our first product, Nerva, helps healthcare providers treat their GI patients with brain-gut therapy delivered through software. Backed by a randomized controlled trial in which 81% of patients saw meaningful improvement in their symptom management, Nerva has grown to help more than 300,000 people and become trusted by thousands of clinicians.

Behind it is the world’s largest proprietary dataset in gut-brain therapy — millions hypnotherapy sessions, real consult transcripts, paired symptom data, and proven clinical protocols. By applying AI to this foundation, we’re creating digital therapeutics that can match — and sometimes exceed — the outcomes and personal connection of human care.

Our vision is simple: when someone is diagnosed with a condition like IBS, their doctor won’t just prescribe a pill — they’ll prescribe an AI therapeutic that taps into the power of the mind to treat the body.

about_short_description.short_description: Mindset Health uses AI-powered apps to deliver hypnotherapy and mind-body programs for chronic health and mental wellness.

product.name: Nerva
product.description: A mobile app delivering gut-directed hypnotherapy to help users self-manage irritable bowel syndrome (IBS) symptoms.

product.name: Evia
product.description: A five-week digital hypnotherapy program to help manage menopausal hot flashes, night sweats, insomnia, anxiety, and depression.

product.name: Finito
product.description: A structured, app-based hypnotherapy program to support smoking cessation and manage withdrawal symptoms.

product.name: Claria
product.description: A five-week digital hypnotherapy program to help users self-manage anxiety, depression, and stress.

product.name: Relio
product.description: A six-week digital program combining hypnotherapy and pain science education to help users manage chronic lower back pain.

product.name: Nerva gut-brain therapy program
product.description: A digital gut-brain therapy program using CBT-informed coaching, gut-directed hypnotherapy and breathing to manage IBS and other gut-brain disorders.
